sentence: Krakowski et al. place the imitation barrier in the bundle of human and machine capabilities rather than in either part
passage: [Krakowski et al. (2023), p. 1446] "Our findings show that humans remain sources of sustainable advantage by combining and integrating their capabilities with machine capabilities into uniquely complementary bundles (Argyres & Zenger, 2012)." / "the locus of sustainable advantage is neither human nor machine capabilities, but what humans do with these capabilities."

gemini.note: The passage explicitly states that sustainable advantage stems from complementary bundles of human and machine capabilities rather than either in isolation, fully supporting the sentence's claim.
